title.en: DeepSeek Promotes V4-Flash to Official Public Beta API with Updated Post-Training
title.zhHans: DeepSeek 将 V4-Flash 升格为官方 API 公测版并更新后训练权重

searchSummary.en: DeepSeek moved DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 from preview to an official public beta API, retaining its 284B MoE architecture with updated post-training.
searchSummary.zhHans: DeepSeek 将 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 从预览版移至官方 API 公测版，保持 2840 亿参数 MoE 架构并更新后训练权重。

summary.en: On July 31, 2026, DeepSeek promoted DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 from preview to an official public beta API, retaining its 284B parameter MoE architecture while improving post-trained agent capabilities and cost efficiency.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 7 月 31 日，DeepSeek 将 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 从预览版升格为官方 API 公测版，保持其 2840 亿参数的 MoE 架构不变，同时提升了后训练智能体能力与性价比。

narrative.en: DeepSeek released an updated official API public beta checkpoint named DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731. The model retains its 284 billion total parameter Mixture-of-Experts architecture (13 billion active parameters per token) while integrating a fresh round of fine-tuning that improves tool-use, terminal coding, and long-horizon reasoning. Available via DeepSeek's official API at $0.14 per million input tokens, the release also added native support for OpenAI's Responses API format and local Codex execution.
narrative.zhHans: DeepSeek 发布了名为 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 的更新版官方 API 公测检查点。该模型保持其 2840 亿总参数（每 token 激活 130 亿参数）的混合专家（MoE）架构不变，同时融入了新一轮微调，提升了工具调用、终端编程及长程推理能力。该模型通过 DeepSeek 官方 API 提供，定价每百万输入 token $0.14，并新增了对 OpenAI Responses API 格式与本地 Codex 执行的原生支持。

description.en: Provides high-throughput open-weight MoE model API at ultra-low inference costs.
description.zhHans: 以极低推理成本提供高吞吐开源 MoE 模型 API。

text.en: DeepSeek transitioned DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 from preview to an official public beta API on July 31, 2026, featuring 284B total parameters and 13B active parameters at $0.14 per M input tokens.
text.zhHans: DeepSeek 于 2026 年 7 月 31 日将 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 从预览版升级为官方 API 公测版，拥有 2840 亿总参数与 130 亿激活参数，定价每百万输入 token $0.14。

text.en: Provides an open-weight lightweight MoE checkpoint achieving high intelligence scores on low inference cost constraints.
text.zhHans: 提供了一款开源轻量 MoE 模型检查点，在极低推理成本约束下取得了较高的智能测评成绩。

text.en: The update was limited to the V4-Flash model checkpoint; V4-Pro and web application models remained unchanged until mid-August.
text.zhHans: 本次更新仅限于 V4-Flash 模型检查点；V4-Pro 与网页端在 8 月中旬前维持原有版本。
